findings.reason: The inspected original tile contains the mesh construction and centered equation but no spatial illustration. A two-part mesh/stencil picture materially clarifies which values are prescribed and which are unknown, and makes the negative neighboring coefficients and positive central coefficient visible. This is warranted explanatory content under the authorized diagram criterion, despite the existing complete procedural definition.
findings.action: Added a schematic mesh and centered three-point stencil in the existing Remarks section, with boundary and N=1 qualifications.

correction: Added only explanatory Remarks prose and one fenced TikZ illustration of the zero-boundary mesh and coefficients (-1,2,-1)/h^2.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Mesh nodes x_0,x_1,...,x_N,x_{N+1} on [0,1], values U_0,...,U_{N+1}.
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition line 33 gives h=1/(N+1), x_j=jh, hence x_0=0, x_1=h, x_N=Nh, x_{N+1}=1. The upper diagram labels those four positions and distinguishes the endpoint values U_0=U_{N+1}=0 from U_1,...,U_N. The omitted interior nodes are schematic; caption restricts this upper sketch to N>=2.

Definition line 35 is exactly (-U_{j-1}+2U_j-U_{j+1})/h^2=g_j. The lower figure assigns -1/h^2 to both neighboring values and 2/h^2 to U_j, and shows the two adjacent spacings as h since x_j-x_{j-1}=x_{j+1}-x_j=h. These are coefficients of the full centered equation, including prescribed endpoints when j=1 or N; no extra matrix column is asserted.

At j=1 or j=N one neighboring value is a prescribed zero endpoint. At N=1 the lower stencil is U_0,U_1,U_2 and both neighbors are prescribed endpoints, as stated in the caption. Thus the illustration does not exclude the admissible N=1 input.

proof_independence_note: The unchanged exact-arithmetic algorithm, recurrence and final equation check define the procedure independently of the illustration; no correctness or error theorem is inferred from the picture.
